name: Sustainable Land Use Grant Call for Southeast Asia

funder.name: Sustainable Land Use Community (Philanthropy Asia Alliance)

summary: First grant call of a philanthropic coalition funding locally led projects in Southeast Asia, with one track to protect, restore and sustainably manage forests, peatlands and mangroves, and another for sustainable agriculture.

amount.note: Catalytic funding for shortlisted projects, from S$200,000

status.quote: Applications open on 10 September 2026. The window closes on 31 December 2026.

opens.quote: Applications open on 10 September 2026. The window closes on 31 December 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications open on 10 September 2026. The window closes on 31 December 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Civil society and non-governmental organisations • Community-based and locally led groups • Government agencies and public institutions • Academic and research institutions • International organisations and UN agencies • Mission-aligned for-profit organisations, including impact enterprises

geography.quote: The proposed initiative must be implemented in Southeast Asia.

access.quote: The SLC is opening its inaugural grant call for high-potential, locally led projects
